snippet.title: HypeHype LIVE Gaming - Did you know there's an app that combines live streaming and gaming?
snippet.description:
HypeHype is where LIVE gaming meets streamers and players!

HypeHype is where LIVE gaming meets streamers, gamers and players for unforgettable live moments. Join daily events, squad up with the live streamers & the community, and experience gaming in a brand new way!

● Play LIVE: a feed of live gaming events with the funniest game modes and top streamers.
● Instant join: tap to enter the live game the streamer is hosting for you. Influence the game with boosters and more.
● Chat & shoutouts: play live to earn kudos and gifts, give shoutouts for the top plays.
● Find top streamers: follow your favorite streamers and get notified when they go LIVE, so you won't miss the play. Become the Top Fan!
● Go LIVE: Start hosting your own live games on any device and play with the community. Earn with gifts and subs!

Download HypeHype today on your iOS, Android, Windows or Mac: https://hypehype.com/en/download

For live streamers and creators: Interested in streaming games on HypeHype and getting paid? Get in touch via https://hypehype.com/en/live-streamer-beta-program-new

HypeHype is developed by the creators of BADLAND, Badland Brawl, Badland Party, Rumble Stars Football, and Rumble Hockey
